description: This file defines classes and functions for generating a deferred revenue and expense report within the ERPNext system, including data processing, report generation, and chart preparation.

classes.name: Deferred_Item
classes.description: Helper class for processing individual deferred revenue/expense items, including calculation, report data generation, and simulation of future postings.

classes.name: Deferred_Invoice
classes.description: Helper class for processing invoices containing deferred items, aggregating item data, and calculating period-wise revenue/expense.

classes.name: Deferred_Revenue_and_Expense_Report
classes.description: Main class for generating the deferred revenue and expense report, managing data retrieval, calculations, and chart preparation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point function to generate the deferred revenue and expense report, returning report columns, data, messages, and chart.
